result.summary: The screen appears mostly functional, but there is one significant visual layout issue regarding the text alignment and clipping in the category filter bar.

issues.description: The category filter chips (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) have inconsistent internal spacing or font weight leading to text alignment issues, and the right-most visible chip 'Healthy' is tight against the edge, though the prompt excludes partial visibility of the very last item, the alignment of the text labels inside the chips looks slightly off-center.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the padding and alignment settings for the category filter chips to ensure consistent centering of text within the capsules.

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom of the screen has a '-20%' discount badge that is not centered relative to its parent container's aesthetic constraints or appears slightly detached from the design language used in the top cards.
issues.suggestion: Ensure consistent badge positioning and sizing across all restaurant/item cards for a uniform visual hierarchy.
